info.title: Restaurant Costing, Purchasing & FIFO Inventory API

post.description: First-run only: creates the branch and its owner. Refused once any user exists.

Record a quoted/market price without a purchase (e.g. before the first delivery).
Updates the CURRENT cost; does not add stock.
Cost an unsaved recipe (live editor). Nothing is written.

Confirm a purchase. Atomically records it, adds stock batches, updates prices,
re-costs recipes and the supplier balance. Requires an Idempotency-Key header.
Dry run: checks arithmetic, units, duplicates. Writes nothing.

get.description: Preview what a production run would deduct (no posting).
Reconciles dashboard figures with the underlying records.
